arguments.value: This agreement is between Fidelity Investments Institutional Operations Company, Inc. and New York Life Insurance and Annuity Corporation. It takes effect on January 1, 1998, and no fixed end date is stated; instead, it continues until terminated under the agreement. Fidelity will provide New York Life with periodic information about the Fidelity Variable Insurance Products Funds, including investment objectives, policies, holdings, and performance, so New York Life can answer customer and prospect inquiries about the funds. New York Life may use only the information Fidelity provides, without changing it, and may need to add required disclosures or qualifiers before sharing it externally. In return, Fidelity pays New York Life a quarterly fee based on the average daily assets New York Life holds in the funds, subject to a stated cap. New York Life may terminate the agreement at any time with written notice, Fidelity may terminate on 90 days' notice, or immediately in certain circumstances, and the agreement ends automatically if New York Life’s participation agreements with the funds end. The agreement is governed by Massachusetts law and generally cannot be assigned without consent, except to a successor transfer agent.
